name: dinn-pharma-stock
description: Read-only pharmaceutical stock availability, rupture, ranking, point-of-sale, and product-location intelligence for authenticated Dinn customers.

interface.longDescription: Dinn Pharma Stock helps pharmaceutical industry professionals understand where stock availability needs attention. Check executive indicators, rupture trends, rankings by SKU or retail network, and the most critical points of sale. Explore store-level detail and locate nearby products on interactive maps. Responses state the data's scope and freshness, distinguish observed values from estimates, and respect the authenticated account's portfolio and permissions. The plugin is read-only: it never changes stock, records, or operational data.
defaultPrompt: Show me my company's stock availability dashboard.
Show the weekly rupture trend for this product over the last 90 days.
Which retail networks have the highest rupture concentration for this product?
